name: Columbus (Indiana, United States)
description: The city's brand banner: a blue lower half with a white skyline of the city's landmark architecture and the words Columbus, Indiana, under a fan of rays in green, orange, red, purple and yellow, charged with the city's green C logo.
history: Columbus is a city in and the county seat of Bartholomew County, Indiana. The flag was adopted in 2000, according to Flags of the World.

features.role: skyline of the city's architecture and the words Columbus, Indiana
fan of coloured rays in green, orange, red, purple and yellow
